glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Nifty options trade in lots of 65 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹65 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
Iron condor
A call spread and a put spread sold together. You collect both premiums; it pays if Nifty stays between the two sold strikes, and the loss is capped.

calls.result: Right: stayed inside the box (low 58,878, high 59,741) and leaned up, closing at its high (+655 pts, 59,086 → 59,741); the 58,600–58,800 buy dip never came, no trade

calls.call: Wednesday: stay between 59,000 and 60,500, leaning up; buy a dip to 59,200–59,400, don't sell short before 60,400
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty closed at its high, 59,741; big traders placed 31,000 new bets that it won't fall and under 2,000 that it won't rise, with a fresh floor at 59,000
calls.result: Wrong: closed Wednesday at 60,792, above the 60,600 line (+1,051 pts, 59,741 → 60,792); the lean up was right, the box was not; no readings during Wednesday, judged on the close

calls.call: Rest of Thursday: stay between 60,500 and 61,600, leaning up; buy a dip to 60,750–60,900, don't sell short before 61,500
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty broke above Wednesday's 60,600 line and reached 61,406 today; big traders placed 11,000 new bets that it won't fall below 61,000, and 39,000 new bets that it won't fall against 17,000 that it won't rise
calls.result: Right: stayed inside the box (high 61,546) and leaned up (61,071 → 61,519, +448 pts); the 60,750–60,900 buy dip never came, no trade

calls.call: Rest of Thursday: stay between 60,700 and 62,000, leaning up; buy a dip to 60,900–61,050, don't sell short before 61,900
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty made a new high at 61,486 with only 16,500 bets that it stays under 61,500, while 14,500 new bets came in today that it won't fall below 61,000; the real ceiling is 62,000
calls.result: Right: box held and it leaned up (61,453 → 61,519, +66 pts); the 60,900–61,050 buy dip never came, no trade

calls.call: Friday: stay between 60,700 and 62,000, leaning up; buy a dip to 60,900–61,100, don't sell short before 61,900
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty closed up 726 points at 61,519, near its high; big traders placed 48,000 new bets today that it won't fall against 14,000 that it won't rise, with 14,000 of them at 61,000
calls.result: Right on the box only (low 60,781, high 61,301): the lean up was wrong, it closed down 484 at 61,034 (61,519 → 61,034); the 60,900–61,100 dip buy ended about flat and 61,900 never came. No readings during Friday, judged on the close and daily range

calls.call: Monday: stay between 60,400 and 61,600, no lean; buy a dip to 60,500–60,650, sell only a stall at 61,350–61,500
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty fell 484 to 61,034 and both sides cut about 6,000 bets; 6,000 new bets that it stays under 61,000 came in as it fell, so the lean up is withdrawn
calls.result: Right on the box only (closed 61,576, inside 60,400–61,600, though the 61,713 high poked above it): selling the 61,350–61,500 stall lost about 125 points at the close, and the 60,500–60,650 dip never came

calls.call: Rest of Monday: stay between 60,900 and 61,800, leaning up; buy a dip to 61,000–61,150, don't sell short before 61,700
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty bounced 361 points; big traders placed 29,000 new bets that it won't fall against 12,700 that it won't rise, with a fresh floor at 61,000
calls.result: Right: stayed inside the box (high 61,713) and leaned up (61,379 → 61,576, +197 pts); the 61,000–61,150 buy dip never came, no trade

calls.call: Rest of Monday: stay between 61,200 and 62,100, leaning up; buy a dip to 61,300–61,450, don't sell short before 61,950
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty is back at its 61,713 high; big traders placed 35,000 new bets today that it won't fall against 5,000 that it won't rise, with new floors at 61,300 and 61,500
calls.result: Right: box held; the 61,300–61,450 dip came at 2:15 pm (61,356) and buying it made about 200 points by the 61,576 close, though the lean from 61,640 itself ended −64

calls.call: Tuesday: stay between 61,300 and 62,100, leaning up; buy a dip to 61,450–61,600, don't sell short before 62,000
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty held the 61,300 floor all Monday and opened higher at 61,689; big traders hold 29,000 bets that it won't fall below 61,000 against 25,600 that it stays under 62,000
calls.result: Wrong: broke above the 62,250 line, our 11:15 reading was 62,276 after a 62,325 high (+510 pts, 61,767 → 62,276); the lean up was right, the box was not; the 61,450–61,600 dip came at the open (low 61,488) and buying it made about 750 points

calls.call: Rest of Tuesday: stay between 61,800 and 62,600, leaning up; buy a dip to 61,950–62,100, don't sell short before 62,500
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty broke above the 62,000 ceiling to 62,241, out of the 61,300–62,100 box; since the open big traders placed 11,300 new bets that it won't fall below 62,000 and 7,500 that it won't fall below 61,500
